expected_impact: Separates temperature, top-k, and top-p effects on c16 sequence diversity and realism without changing model weights. It adds temperature 0.6 and cannot establish biological function or adaptive-memory benefit.
rationale: The first c16 generation study showed severe tokenizer-aligned 6-mer concentration under top-k 128. A factorized decoding screen is needed before attributing the concentration to training or allocating A100 compute.
